script:
Moonshot AI just dropped Kimi K3.1 Pro — and the AI race with China just got faster again.

Released this week across Kimi.ai, its mobile apps, Kimi Code, and the API, the model scored 55 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — an 11-point jump over its predecessor. It's especially strong at coding and 3D work, reportedly able to build full games in Unreal and Unity and handle parametric modeling in Blender and CAD. Open weights are set to land November 4th.

But the rollout isn't clean: reports allege Moonshot paid influencers to hype the model without disclosing the relationship. Either way, frontier-grade AI from Chinese labs is now shipping on a weekly cadence — not quarterly.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
